What's new

- Background downloads now tell you when they are ready, including a tray notification while WinPreview is minimised.
- Restart installs the new version silently and reopens the app where you were.
- Install when I close is still there if you would rather finish your work first.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.5 - update readiness notification: the tray announces a finished background download when the window is hidden; restart installs silently and relaunches.
